"""design_2340 모델링 준비: tp 단위 데이터셋 구성 + 분할 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"; O = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.load(open(D.parent / "design_2340.json"))
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time","discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time","report_time"])

def kdigo(times, vals, ref_t, ref_v):
    """각 (times, vals) 측정이 KDIGO Cr 기준을 만족하는지: 48h 내 +0.3, 또는 7일 내 최솟값 x1.5.
    비교 기준값은 ref (같은 입원, 해당 측정 이전)."""
    out = []
    for t, v in zip(times, vals):
        m48 = (ref_t < t) & (ref_t >= t - 48*H)
        m7 = (ref_t < t) & (ref_t >= t - 168*H)
        hit = (m48.any() and v - ref_v[m48].min() >= 0.3) or (m7.any() and v >= 1.5*ref_v[m7].min())
        out.append(bool(hit))
    return np.array(out, dtype=bool)

# tp 그리드
tps = a.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tps["tp"] = tps.admit_time + tps.offset_h*H
tps["in_hosp_at_tp"] = tps.tp < tps.discharge_time
tps["full_window_in_hosp"] = tps.tp + 48*H <= tps.discharge_time
tps = tps.merge(p, on="patient_id")

cr = l[l.test=="creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
crg = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}
labs_g = {k: g for k, g in l.groupby("admission_id")}

rows = []
for r in tps.itertuples():
    g = labs_g.get(r.admission_id, l.iloc[:0]); c = crg.get(r.admission_id, cr.iloc[:0])
    known = g[(g.report_time >= r.admit_time) & (g.report_time <= r.tp)]
    def agg(test, f, start=r.admit_time, end=r.tp, df=None):
        s = (df if df is not None else g); s = s[(s.test==test)&(s.report_time>=start)&(s.report_time<=end)].sort_values("report_time").value
        return np.nan if s.empty and f!="count" else {"min":s.min,"max":s.max,"last":lambda: s.iloc[-1],"count":s.size.__int__}[f]()
    # 제외: tp까지 보고된 Cr로 KDIGO AKI (기준값도 tp까지 보고된 것만)
    ck = c[(c.report_time>=r.admit_time)&(c.report_time<=r.tp)]
    aki_known = kdigo(ck.collect_time, ck.value.values, ck.collect_time, ck.value.values).any() if len(ck) else False
    # 결과: [tp, tp+48h) 채취 Cr, 기준값 [tp-168h, tp) 채취 + 창 내 이전 측정 (index admission 한정)
    cw = c[(c.collect_time>=r.tp)&(c.collect_time<r.tp+48*H)]
    cref = c[(c.collect_time>=r.tp-168*H)&(c.collect_time<r.tp+48*H)]
    y = kdigo(cw.collect_time, cw.value.values, cref.collect_time, cref.value.values).any() if len(cw) else False
    rows.append(dict(admission_id=r.admission_id, offset_h=r.offset_h, aki_known_by_tp=aki_known,
        aki_48h=int(y), n_cr_outcome_window=len(cw),
        cr_min_adm=agg("creatinine","min"), k_last=agg("potassium","last"), n_cr=agg("creatinine","count"),
        cr_last=agg("creatinine","last"), hgb_min=agg("hemoglobin","min"),
        cr_max_adm=agg("creatinine","max", end=r.discharge_time),   # 설계 그대로 (누설: 보고서 참조)
        bun_last=agg("bun","last"), cr_max_48h=agg("creatinine","max", start=r.tp-48*H)))
ds = tps[["admission_id","patient_id","family_id","offset_h","tp","unit","age","sex","in_hosp_at_tp","full_window_in_hosp"]].merge(pd.DataFrame(rows), on=["admission_id","offset_h"])

# 코호트
ds["included"] = (ds.age>=18) & ~ds.aki_known_by_tp
# 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. 결측 family_id는 patient_id로 대체(설계 미명시 → 보고서 참조)
ds["split_group"] = ds.family_id.fillna("PT_"+ds.patient_id)
grp = ds.split_group.drop_duplicates().sort_values().to_numpy()
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"]); rng.shuffle(grp)
test_g = set(grp[:int(round(len(grp)*design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
ds["split"] = np.where(ds.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")
ds.to_csv(O/"tp_dataset.csv.gz", index=False)
print("saved", ds.shape)
EOF
